facts.text: Hayes Mansion is a California Historical Landmark and listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
Early on, the property was self‑sufficient, with its own power plant, a post office, railroad station, carriage stop, lodgings for 40 ranch hands, and a chapel.
Originally the home of the Hayes family, the mansion is regarded as one of the best examples of late 19th‑century Mission Revival architecture in the Santa Clara Valley.
Hayes Valley is often listed among San Francisco’s top neighborhoods for historic charm with modern amenities.
The mansion now operates as a hotel resort called Hayes Mansion San Jose, part of the Curio Collection by Hilton.
The building houses 33,000 square feet of meeting space and 214 guest rooms, surrounded by 20 acres of Edenvale Gardens Regional Park.
